sourceText: User (2026-07-24, translated from Chinese chat): After forensic confirmation that the B-bf52 quorum poisoning was real, the user instructed: execute option 2, the tool-defect fix story - align the quorum_submit duplicate guard with the floor drift-accept predicate and add a recovery command; the runId-scheme migration is explicitly deferred. Standing demand from the same thread: the tool must make it impossible for a redundant re-run to destroy already-valid evidence again.
normalizedOutcome: After a merge that changes materialHash but not storyFilesHash, a redundant quorum_submit re-run is refused with a message naming the standing drift-accepted quorum (instead of silently poisoning every round), and a quorum_prune command can recover any already-poisoned story by removing the duplicate host-verdict events (dry-run first, backup, metadata commit).
acceptanceClaim: The quorum-submit smoke suite proves both: (a) the redundant cross-material re-submit that previously collapsed all rounds to duplicate host/session/key identity is now refused with no events written, and (b) quorum_prune dry-run lists exactly the duplicate verdict events and apply restores one verdict per host per round so the escalation floor returns to full-3x2.
